text: 《指导意见》征求意见稿主要包括以下内容：明确了加快推进会计数智化工作的指导思想、工作原则和总体目标。强化会计数智化法规制度机制保障。提出贯彻落实相关法规制度，完善会计相关制度规范，建立健全会计数智化建设评价机制与案例推广机制，夯实会计数智化工作的制度基础。加强会计数智化标准体系建设。部署健全完善会计核算数据标准、管理会计数据指标标准、内部控制报告数据标准、可持续信息披露数据标准、数字函证数据标准、注册会计师审计数据标准、会计数智化产品标准、加强会计数智化标准国际合作，构建系统完备的会计数智化标准体系。
text_en: The draft for comments of the "Guiding Opinions" mainly includes the following contents: It clarifies the guiding ideology, working principles, and overall goals for accelerating the advancement of accounting digital-intelligence work. It strengthens the legal and institutional mechanism guarantees for accounting digital-intelligence. It proposes implementing relevant laws and regulations, improving accounting-related institutional norms, establishing and perfecting evaluation mechanisms and case promotion mechanisms for accounting digital-intelligence construction, and solidifying the institutional foundation for accounting digital-intelligence work. It strengthens the construction of accounting digital-intelligence standards system. It deploys the improvement of accounting calculation data standards, management accounting data indicator standards, internal control report data standards, sustainable information disclosure data standards, digital confirmation data standards, certified public accountant audit data standards, accounting digital-intelligence product standards, and strengthening international cooperation on accounting digital-intelligence standards, to build a systematic and comprehensive accounting digital-intelligence standards system.
